teaching_point_ja: （事件などを）取材・報道する
alt_ja: その記者は選挙を取材・報道した。
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 140"><rect width="320" height="140" rx="12" fill="#F8FAFE"/><rect x="22" y="27" width="112" height="84" rx="5" fill="white" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="2"/><text x="78" y="44" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4568DF">LIVE</text><circle cx="79" cy="67" r="16" fill="#E2EAFE"/><text x="79" y="72" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" fill="#152238">記者</text><path d="M79 85L79 99" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M146 69L186 69" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M178 64L186 69L178 74" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/><rect x="202" y="29" width="93" height="80" rx="5" fill="white" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="2"/><text x="248" y="49" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle" fill="#152238">選挙</text><path d="M218 61L276 61" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M218 72L264 72" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M218 83L273 83" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><text x="160" y="129" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" fill="#152238">現場を取材 → ニュースとして伝える</text></svg>

alt_ja: 彼女は父親と同じ業種で働いている。
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 140"><rect width="320" height="140" rx="12" fill="#F8FAFE"/><rect x="15" y="20" width="290" height="98" rx="5" fill="white" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="2"/><text x="60" y="38" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle" fill="#64748B">職業分野</text><rect x="35" y="52" width="70" height="48" rx="5" fill="#E5EDFF" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="2"/><text x="70" y="81" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" text-anchor="middle" fill="#152238">医療</text><rect x="125" y="52" width="70" height="48" rx="5" fill="#E5EDFF" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="2"/><text x="160" y="81" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" text-anchor="middle" fill="#152238">教育</text><rect x="215" y="52" width="70" height="48" rx="5" fill="#E5EDFF" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="2"/><text x="250" y="81" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" text-anchor="middle" fill="#152238">建築</text><text x="160" y="131" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4568DF">同じ line = 同じ業種・仕事の分野</text></svg>

alt_ja: 通電している電線には触れないでください。
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 140"><rect width="320" height="140" rx="12" fill="#F8FAFE"/><path d="M28 72L290 72" stroke="#94A3B8" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M45 34L45 70" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M45 34L87 34" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M87 34L87 70" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><text x="66" y="24" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle" fill="#152238">電源ON</text><path d="M113 72L135 72" stroke="#D97777" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="123" cy="72" r="14" fill="none"/><path d="M113 62L133 82" stroke="#D97777" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><text x="123" y="105" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle" fill="#D97777">危険</text><text x="224" y="44" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#152238">通電中の電線</text><text x="224" y="105" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4568DF">触れない</text></svg>

alt_ja: 2日ごとに植物に水をやってください。
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 140"><rect width="320" height="140" rx="12" fill="#F8FAFE"/><rect x="17" y="84" width="286" height="16" rx="5" fill="#E8F4E8" stroke="#81B38A" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M75 85L75 56" stroke="#268A5B" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M75 70L56 54" stroke="#268A5B" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M75 66L94 49" stroke="#268A5B" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="57" cy="51" r="9" fill="#A9D5A8"/><circle cx="95" cy="47" r="9" fill="#A9D5A8"/><rect x="160" y="22" width="50" height="38" rx="5" fill="white" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M182 60L152 85" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="149" cy="72" r="3" fill="#60A5FA"/><circle cx="137" cy="82" r="3" fill="#60A5FA"/><circle cx="162" cy="81" r="3" fill="#60A5FA"/><text x="246" y="42" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4568DF">水をやる</text><text x="161" y="124" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle" fill="#152238">植物に水を与える動作</text></svg>

alt_ja: 私たちはあなたの意見を大切にしています。
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 140"><rect width="320" height="140" rx="12" fill="#F8FAFE"/><rect x="20" y="23" width="112" height="92" rx="5" fill="white" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="2"/><text x="76" y="45" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#152238">あなたの意見</text><path d="M38 60L112 60" stroke="#CBD5E1" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M38 72L104 72" stroke="#CBD5E1" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M38 84L93 84" stroke="#CBD5E1" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M145 67L189 67" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M181 62L189 67L181 72" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/><circle cx="239" cy="66" r="34" fill="#E4F4EE"/><text x="239" y="73" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="29" text-anchor="middle" fill="#0F9D82">★</text><text x="238" y="116" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4568DF">大切に評価する</text></svg>

alt_ja: その投資は安定した収益を生んだ。
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 140"><rect width="320" height="140" rx="12" fill="#F8FAFE"/><rect x="22" y="32" width="83" height="58" rx="5" fill="white" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="2"/><text x="64" y="54" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" text-anchor="middle" fill="#152238">投資</text><text x="64" y="77" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="22" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4568DF">¥</text><path d="M111 64L154 64" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M146 59L154 64L146 69" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/><rect x="171" y="20" width="122" height="94" rx="5" fill="white" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="2"/><text x="231" y="40" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle" fill="#152238">収益</text><rect x="191" y="80" width="17" height="20" rx="5" fill="#E5EDFF" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="217" y="63" width="17" height="37" rx="5" fill="#E5EDFF" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="243" y="47" width="17" height="53" rx="5" fill="#E5EDFF" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="2"/><text x="231" y="127" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4568DF">投資から得る見返り</text></svg>

alt_ja: 彼は一晩で高熱を出した。
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 140"><rect width="320" height="140" rx="12" fill="#F8FAFE"/><circle cx="60" cy="36" r="8" fill="#4568DF"/><path d="M60 46L60 74" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M60 55L47 66" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M60 55L73 66" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M60 74L48 90" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M60 74L72 90" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><rect x="142" y="26" width="145" height="90" rx="5" fill="white" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="2"/><text x="213" y="45" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#152238">体温</text><path d="M174 90L174 55" stroke="#D97777" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="174" cy="94" r="10" fill="#D97777"/><path d="M199 61L252 61" stroke="#CBD5E1" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M199 76L252 76" stroke="#CBD5E1" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><text x="233" y="100" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" text-anchor="middle" fill="#D97777">高熱</text><text x="160" y="130" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4568DF">病気・症状が新たに現れる</text></svg>

alt_ja: その店は3か月間黒字を維持している。
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 140"><rect width="320" height="140" rx="12" fill="#F8FAFE"/><rect x="18" y="22" width="284" height="100" rx="5" fill="white" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="2"/><text x="81" y="44" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#152238">売上</text><text x="238" y="44" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#152238">費用</text><rect x="44" y="54" width="75" height="35" rx="5" fill="#DDF5EA" stroke="#0F9D82" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="202" y="54" width="75" height="35" rx="5" fill="#FDE8E8" stroke="#D97777" stroke-width="2"/><text x="81" y="77" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" text-anchor="middle" fill="#152238">¥120</text><text x="238" y="77" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" text-anchor="middle" fill="#152238">¥90</text><path d="M124 70L197 70" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><text x="160" y="62" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4568DF">></text><text x="160" y="108" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4568DF">利益 +¥30 → 黒字</text></svg>

alt_ja: 数人の生徒が先生の味方をした。
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 140"><rect width="320" height="140" rx="12" fill="#F8FAFE"/><circle cx="60" cy="34" r="8" fill="#4568DF"/><path d="M60 44L60 72" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M60 53L47 64" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M60 53L73 64" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M60 72L48 88" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M60 72L72 88" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="243" cy="34" r="8" fill="#4568DF"/><path d="M243 44L243 72" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M243 53L230 64" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M243 53L256 64" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M243 72L231 88" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M243 72L255 88" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M154 21L154 115" stroke="#94A3B8" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M117 65L184 65" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M176 60L184 65L176 70" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/><text x="154" y="44" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4568DF">支持する側へ</text><rect x="195" y="105" width="97" height="24" rx="5" fill="#E2EAFE" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="2"/><text x="243" y="121" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4568DF">先生の側</text></svg>

alt_ja: そのチームの成績は今年向上した。
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 140"><rect width="320" height="140" rx="12" fill="#F8FAFE"/><rect x="20" y="20" width="280" height="104" rx="5" fill="white" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="2"/><text x="160" y="40" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#152238">チームの実績</text><path d="M54 102L275 102" stroke="#94A3B8" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M54 51L54 102" stroke="#94A3B8" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><rect x="91" y="77" width="46" height="25" rx="5" fill="#C9D7FF" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="185" y="54" width="46" height="48" rx="5" fill="#4568DF" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="2"/><text x="114" y="115" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" fill="#152238">昨年</text><text x="208" y="115" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" fill="#152238">今年</text><path d="M143 79L180 57" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M172 52L180 57L172 62" stroke="#4568DF" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/><text x="253" y="63" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4568DF">向上</text></svg>
